name: UpdateCellOrRange
label: Update Cell or Range in Google Sheet
description: Updates a specific cell or range in a Google Sheet with the provided values.

fields.name: SheetsService
fields.label: Sheets Service
fields.description: The authenticated SheetsService instance (from 'Create Google Sheets Service Instance' activity).

fields.name: SpreadsheetId
fields.label: Spreadsheet ID
fields.description: The ID of the Google Spreadsheet (from the URL: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/{spreadsheetId}/edit).

fields.name: SheetName
fields.label: Sheet Name
fields.description: The name of the sheet tab (e.g., 'Sheet1').

fields.name: Range
fields.label: Range
fields.description: The cell or range to update (e.g., 'A1', 'A1:B2').

fields.name: Values
fields.label: Values
fields.description: The list of values to write. For single row: ['A1','B1']. For multiple rows, use a different activity.

fields.name: RunDelay
fields.label: Run Delay (ms)
fields.description: Optional delay in milliseconds before executing. Helps avoid rate limits.
